Profile 
Since our establishment in the year 2005, we, “Ace International ”, are engaged in manufacturing 
and supplying an optimum quality range of Pharmaceutical Machinery & Spare Parts. Offering Spare 
Parts Of Rapid Mixer Granulator, Fluid Bed Dryer, Capsule Printing Machine Blister Packing Machine, 
Conical Blender, Double Cone Blender, Industrial Blender, Vibro Sifter Machine, Industrial Vibro Sifter, 
Multi Deck Vibro Sifter, Bolus Tablet Press GMP Model, Double Sided Rotary Tablet Machine, Central 
Drive & Pre-Compression Tablet Press GMP Model , Tablet Press, Fluidized Bed Coater , RMG 
Machine Lab Model & Production etc. Reckoned for quality attributes such as dimensional accuracy, 
corrosion & abrasion resistance, long functional life and ﬁne ﬁnish, these components and spare parts 
are utilized extensively in engineering industries. We design and develop these products using 
certiﬁed material to ensure their compliance with international standards. 
Prior to dispatch, the entire range of ﬁnished products is quality tested at our advanced facility on 
various set parameters. Our quality controllers are highly efﬁcient and help us provide top-notch 
quality components and spare parts to the clients located across the nation. In our business 
operations, we are aided by a team of adroit professionals, with whose cooperation we are able to fulﬁll 
the exact requirements of clients and garner a rich Clientele in the market. The infrastructure facility of 
our ﬁrm incorporates latest technology, and is outﬁtted with most advanced machine and tools. 
We hold expertise in offering our clients wide range of Pharmaceutical Machinery Spare parts 
that is valued for smooth functioning, durability and superior quality. We offer them in different technical 
speciﬁcations and are used in varied industrial applications. We offer them in different speciﬁc sizes 
and dimensions and are easy to operate. These products are ﬁtted with rotary action and are available 
at most affordable rates 
Features 
·Efﬁcient working 
·Low maintenance 
·Longer service life 
Product Portfolio 
Our organization is known in the industry for manufacturing and supplying a superior quality 
range of Pharmaceutical Machine & Machine Spare Parts. For our product range, certiﬁed raw 
material is procured from trusted vendors of the market. The extensive product line is fabricated at our 
latest manufacturing facility, using hi-tech machines & tools. Made available in various sizes, material 
and other technical speciﬁcations, these products have helped us efﬁciently cater to the individual 
needs of clients. Known for corrosion & abrasion resistance, dimensional accuracy and tensile 
strength, these products are utilized in various engineering industries. 
Our Team 
We have a proﬁcient team, which enables us to provide our clients with optimum quality range of 
components and spare parts, within the promised time frame. Our ﬁrm is known for nurturing best 
talent of the industry having rich experience in the respective domain. Working in close coordination 
with each other as well as with clients, these professionals enable us to make sure that customers' 
individual demands are met. Training sessions organized at a regular basis help us keep our team 
members abreast with the latest production techniques and market dynamics. Owing to the relentless 
efforts of our professionals, we are able to constantly improve ourselves.

Our team comprises the following members : 
 Procurement personnel (raw material) 
 Technical personnel 
 Market analysts 
 Marketing professionals 
 Quality controllers 
 Sales experts 
 Business managers 
 Skilled workforce 
 Warehousing & packaging personnel 
Why Us? 
We are known to possess immense expertise in manufacturing and supplying a wide range of 
Pharmaceutical Machine Components and Pharmaceutical Machine Spare Parts. These 
components can be provided to the clients in varied technical speciﬁcations, in accordance with their 
speciﬁc requirements. Timely delivery of our spare parts and components is another of our strong 
points. We have gained an edge over our competitors owing to the following reasons: 
 Team of experts with rich experience 
 Our products' market demand 
 Best quality at a reasonable price 
 Industry experience 
 Our qualied management team 
 Timely delivery 
Sales & Service 
We provide the various forms of AMC to our new and existing clients. We take two types of AMC: 
Comprehensive Contract Non-Comprehensive Contract AMC CONTRACT FEATURES: Preventive 
Maintenance: Any electronics product required timely service so that your systems will function 
Properly. Every month our Engineer visits once apart from any problem and routine Preventive 
maintenance. Standby Support: If any of your parts are not working and it has to take to Service Center. 
we will be providing Standby support. So that breakdown time of your Machine is minimum. Residence 
Engineer: If you have more than ﬁfty machine we will be providing you residence Engineer. NOTE:- You 
could also for an online quote or e-mail us for customs AMCs.

Tablet Press Tooling - Die & Punch 
Precise Perfect Finish Tablet Press Tooling 
Application & Process : 
ACE- Punch & Dies are manufactured in-house with state of art machines. The raw material used in the 
production of tablets is compressed by a pressure of several tons on a small area of a few square 
millimeters, to produce a visually perfect tablet. There fore Tablet press tooling the is required harder 
and smoother and good ﬁnish surface. Prism has developed an advance technological system 
especially for manufacturing of precise, perfect and ﬁnished tablet tools. 
Salient Features :  
·Choice for material of construction of Die and Punch- 
1. OHNS (T) Oil Hardened Non shrinking steel (Tungsten) - AISI 01 
2. HCHC - High carbon High chromium steel - AISI D3 
·Tooling size as per EURO, IPT Standards and Special tooling. 
·Can be manufactured any shape of the tooling. 
·Can be manufactured Multi tips and Polo type tooling. 
·Careful matching of material and hardness. 
·Trouble free ﬁtting and removal 
·Manufactured to the smallest tolerances. 
·High Precision ﬁnish.

CAPSULE FILLING MACHINE 
The Manual Capsule Filling Machine is one of the 
oldest as well as the most popular and widely used 
form of capsule ﬁlling. The machine is designed and 
manufactured with utmost care to handle all sizes 
ranging from 00 to 5 and to give you trouble free 
services year after year. 
Though all the operations are manual, the machine 
calls for precision machined components and 
assembled with highly skilled personnel. 
The manual capsule ﬁlling machine is widely used in 
research laboratories, academic institution and 
medium to small scale manufacturing industries. 
You have the option of buying an Automatic Capsule 
Loading Machine, which speeds up the production 
activity, as the maximum time taken is for the loading 
of capsules manually on the loading trays of the 
capsule ﬁller

Key Features 
1. High Efficiency: Capable of filling a large number of capsules quickly, significantly boosting production rates. 
2. Precision Filling: Ensures accurate dosages, minimizing waste and ensuring consistent product quality. 
3. Versatile Capsule Sizes: Can accommodate different capsule sizes (e.g., gelatin or vegetarian capsules). 
4. User-Friendly Controls: Often features a touchscreen interface for easy operation, monitoring, and adjustments. 
5. Automated Processes: Incorporates automated loading, filling, and closing mechanisms to reduce manual labor. 
6. Safety and Hygiene: Designed with materials that are easy to clean and often include safety features to prevent contamination. 
Common Types 
1. Rotary Capsule Fillers: Utilize a rotating mechanism to fill capsules; suitable for high production volumes. 
2. Linear Capsule Fillers: Use a linear design for filling; ideal for smaller batches and more flexible production. 
3. Peristaltic Fillers: Employ a peristaltic pumping mechanism for gentle and precise filling, especially for sensitive liquids. 
4. Pump-Fed Systems: Use pumps to accurately dispense liquid into the capsules, allowing for various viscosities. 
Applications 
• 
Nutraceuticals: Filling capsules with herbal extracts, vitamins, and dietary supplements. 
• 
Pharmaceuticals: Filling with liquid medications, vaccines, or therapeutic solutions. 
• 
Cosmetics: Filling capsules with oils, serums, or beauty supplements.

Considerations 
When selecting an automatic liquid capsule filling machine, keep in mind: 
• 
Production Capacity: Match the machine’s output with your expected production volume. 
• 
Liquid Properties: Ensure the machine can handle the viscosity and chemical characteristics of your liquid. 
• 
Ease of Cleaning: Look for machines that offer quick and efficient cleaning processes, especially if changing products frequently. 
• 
Space Requirements: Evaluate the machine’s footprint to ensure it fits in your production area. 
• 
Budget: Consider the total cost of ownership, including purchase price, maintenance, and operational costs.
